name: Compute Cluster S83: Forward Returns (Price vs Non-Price Series)
description: Tests: forward_returns on price series (correct), lead-shift difference for non-price/spread series that cross zero (correct alternative), forward_returns on spreads produces inf (trap).
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S83: Forward Returns (Non-Price Trap)
# Tests: forward_returns on price OK, on spreads WRONG (inf), lead-shift correct
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === CORRECT: forward_returns on price (strictly positive) ===
fwd_ret_5d = forward_returns(close, 5)
fwd_ret_20d = forward_returns(close, 20)

# === SPREAD SERIES (can cross zero) ===
fast_sma = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
spread = fast_sma - slow_sma    # crosses zero

# === WRONG: forward_returns on spread → inf when crossing zero ===
# forward_returns computes (future / current) - 1
# When current crosses zero, this produces +/-inf
spread_fwd_wrong = forward_returns(spread, 20)

# === CORRECT: lead-shift and difference for non-price series ===
spread_fwd_correct = (spread << 20) - spread

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Forward Returns on Price (correct)',
    category='Forward Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='5d Fwd Return', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d Fwd Return', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fwd_ret_5d, fwd_ret_20d))

xy_lines(
    title='SMA Spread (crosses zero)',
    category='Forward Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spread', color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread)

xy_lines(
    title='Spread Forward Change: lead-shift (correct)',
    category='Forward Returns',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lead-Shift Diff (correct)', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=spread_fwd_correct)

cards(
    category='Forward Returns',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Method Comparison', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Price Fwd Ret Avg', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Spread Lead-Diff Avg', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
    ])
)(fwd_ret_20d, spread_fwd_correct)
